Before a [[Third Galactic War|new conflict]] between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], a secretive group of [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] '''gourmands''' existed. The gluttons were responsible for selling captive [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosians]] to the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Malora]], who transformed the former [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]] into [[mutated Geonosian]]s.<ref name="CX" />
